sessions. Increased UAT success rate to 98% by defining comprehensive acceptance criteria and test scenarios. Improved cross-functional delivery timelines by 20% through streamlined stakeholder communication and requirement management.

Reduced requirement clarification cycles by 30% through comprehensive BRD and functional specifications.
Improved UAT success rate to 98% by ensuring complete and traceable business requirements.
Achieved 100% SLA compliance through proactive monitoring and performance reviews. • Supported the successful delivery of 10+ cross-functional projects with zero critical post-production defects. • Reduced issue resolution turnaround time by 25% through effective stakeholder coordination. • Managed requirements for 5+ enterprise system integrations across e-Commerce, OMS, WMS, and Finance platforms.
AXA Business Services India Ltd, Pune - Business Analyst Client: Alliance Bernstein, USA | June 2008- July 2012 Domain: Capital Markets | Wealth Management | Treasury Operations
Led digital SMA account onboarding, reducing onboarding time by 60%. • • Automated AML/KYC validations, improving data accuracy and compliance. •
Implemented Portfolio Accounting Management Systems for the trust and non-trust accounts of Alliance Bernstein with impacted to various model portfolios.
Reduced discrepancies in $1M+ cash flows by 40% via reconciliation workflow improvements. • Collaborated with custodians and IA teams, increasing trade accuracy by 25%. • Authored 50+ user stories, Epics, and SOPs in JIRA & Confluence. • Achieved 100% UAT sign-off across 10+ modules. • Maintained 97% SLA adherence in reporting cycles. • Automated SMA account processes, cutting manual effort by 80% and processing time by 50%. • • • Ensured 99.5% accuracy in trade, reconciliation, and corporate action tracking. Supported MDM, data governance, and compliance with US regulations. Enhanced real-time data integration for Equities, FX, bonds, and derivatives to support portfolio management decisions.
